source.originalDescription: Increases Attack by 8% for 5 seconds after Charizard gets hit.

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Breathes fire at opposing Pokémon, dealing damage 4 times per basic attack. Charizard may move while attacking but is slowed by 5% while breathing fire. Charizard deals additional damage to opposing Pokémon that have been burned by the user's moves. This additional damage cannot land critical hits; additional damage benefits from regular lifesteal. Basic attacks gain increased range upon evolving into Charmeleon and into Charizard.

source.name: Flame Burst
source.originalDescription: The user attacks with a flame in the designated direction which bursts on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and burning them for 4s (dealing damage 5 times). When this move hits, the user's movement speed is increased by 20% for 3s. The Attack of opposing Pokémon burned by this move is decreased by 5%.

source.name: Fire Spin
source.originalDescription: The user shoots fire in the designated direction which bursts into a vortex of fire on the first opposing Pokémon hit or after traveling max distance, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The vortex of fire remains for 5s, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s (up to 10 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 25% for 1s when hit.

source.name: Seismic Slam
source.originalDescription: The user briefly becomes unstoppable and grabs the designated Pokémon from the opposing team. The target is bound, and the user and the target become invincible as the user flies up then slams them onto the ground, damaging the target and nearby opposing Pokémon, dealing an additional 8% max HP damage to each opposing Pokémon hit. The user gains hindrance resistance and mega evolves into Mega Charizard Y the moment they slam into the ground and fly up into the air for 15s. While flying in the air, the user is able to use basic attacks as well as moves and is able to move freely over obstacles. Unite Move basic attacks burn opposing Pokémon for 1s (dealing damage 2 times). The user restores HP for 60% of the damage dealt with Unite Move basic attacks (excluding burns or additional damage). Damage dealt by burns from Unite Move basic attacks also benefit from regular lifesteal. The Attack of opposing Pokémon burned by this move is decreased by 5%. Buffs: 10% Movement Speed, 10% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Seismic Slam は やけどを付与する、バインドを付与する、妨害無効になる、無敵になる、妨害耐性を得る、与ダメージを変化させる、HPを回復する、シールドを付与する、現在HP・最大HP・減少HPなどを参照する、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる、壁・地形・草むらなどと相互作用する、与ダメージに応じて回復する。
